resources.string: Save your recovery mnemonic
Export relay archive
Save this chain’s relay archive without recovery envelopes. Signed objects still need verification before restore; this is not a complete recovery archive.
Repair from retained verified history
Use the chain administrator mnemonic to submit retained current-generation records with their original verified log entries.

This sends retained current-generation encrypted records and their original signed log entries to the selected relay for repair. Each response receipt and the updated transparency checkpoint are verified before local evidence is stored. Local data is retained if repair is incomplete.
Repair accepted %1$d of %2$d retained record(s).
Repair accepted %1$d of %2$d records; some records remain unresolved. Local data was retained.
History repair could not be verified. Local data was retained.
Stage verified history on another relay
Choose the target relay. This stages control history only; it does not create a writable chain or move records.

Review the target relay and enter the chain administrator mnemonic. The relay policy must be current and consented for that origin. This operation only stages signed control history and returns a staging log ID. It does not commit a new generation or move encrypted records.
History staged for chain %1$s. Staging log: %2$s. The target chain is not writable yet.
History could not be staged. No chain switch was committed.
Commit relay reseed

This commits a fresh generation on %1$s, retires the old device identity, replays unresolved local outbox operations, and switches this device to that relay. Verify the target before continuing. Enter the administrator mnemonic again to authorize the commit.
Relay reseed committed. This device now uses the selected relay.
Resume relay reseed
Finish the verified handoff to %1$s. The saved commit and protected keys are reused.
Resume reseed commit
The source is paused while the result is unresolved. Recheck and continue the saved operation for %1$s.
Relay archive saved and its hash verified. Signed objects still need validation before restore.
Export cancelled.
Relay export failed. Local keys and data were retained.
Write down these 24 words in a safe offline place. The app does not retain them. The display closes when you leave this screen or after ten minutes.
I saved these words
Choose the synchronization source
Create a new chain from the data on this device.
Confirm the relay signing key
Compare this fingerprint with the relay operator or an independently trusted device. Confirming this key is a separate trust decision from accepting the storage policy.
Relay storage and deletion policy

This device has been revoked. Its stored data is retained.
Deletion authorization has not been verified. Stored keys and data are retained.
Save deletion evidence offline
The proof file was written and read back byte-for-byte. Confirm that you saved it to a separate offline medium. Only then will this device’s keys and chain data be erased.
The proof is verified and retained locally. This device has not been erased. Save it to an offline medium and confirm to continue.
The evidence file could not be saved and verified. This device’s keys and data were retained.
Export deletion evidence bundle
Save the retained DeleteReceipt and its separate DeletionEvidenceBundle as JSON, including any verified optional witnesses.
Deletion evidence bundle saved and read back successfully.
Confirm intent witness
Import a DeleteReceipt archive, review its chain and deletion ID, and optionally sign an intent witness on this active device.
Sign deletion intent witness?
This device will sign a statement confirming the exact deletion receipt below. It does not authorize deletion or prove physical erasure.\n%1$s
Existing valid witnesses: %1$d
Sign and export witness
Witness bundle saved and read back. Transfer it to the device managing deletion.
Witness export cancelled. No signature was removed from this device.
Witness import cancelled.
The deletion receipt archive could not be read.
This device could not validate or sign the deletion receipt.
Publish a verified snapshot
Create and publish a resumable encrypted snapshot. This does not prune history.
Publishing exact encrypted parts and signed receipts…
The snapshot and its transparency evidence were verified and retained.
Snapshot publication paused. Local signed parts and receipts were retained for retry.
Bootstrap from a trusted snapshot
Review the signed snapshot author and exact coverage before installing it and replaying the suffix.
Choose and trust one snapshot

The relay and signatures authenticate this snapshot, but cannot prove that its author included every earlier item. Trusting semantic completeness is your decision. The client will verify the snapshot commitment and replay the signed suffix before completing initial sync.
No complete verified snapshot for the current epoch is available from this relay.

Inspect and freeze a v2.1 migration source
Verify the source identity and complete read-only history scan, then create a resumable journal. Conversion and upload are separate unfinished steps.
Verify a frozen v2.1 source

Enter the exact HTTPS origin, old chain ID, and an active enrolled v2.1 device key. Enter the same mnemonic and passphrase used by the existing v3 destination. The app performs authenticated read-only requests; stop all old writers first.

I stopped every old client from writing
The protocol has no v2 freeze endpoint. Confirm that old writers are stopped or the source is an immutable export.
Verify source and create migration journal

Frozen v2.1 source revalidated and encrypted records stored as conversion candidates. Conflict resolution, signing, and upload remain incomplete. Selecting the same source and target resumes this journal.
Could not verify the selected source; no migration was started.
The source export contains no records. Its proof and empty conversion journal were verified.
Unresolved protocol evidence

Scheduled key updates are disabled for this chain.

The next scheduled key update is not due yet.
Verify history and receive keys
Verify the complete signed history, receive available keys and resume pending work.
Update synchronization keys
Update keys for approved devices while preserving recovery access. This operation requires the mnemonic holder.
Complete the scheduled key update
Update keys using recovery authority
Use recovery authority to issue fresh keys for the currently approved devices.
Revoke this device
Revoke device %1$s and issue fresh keys to the remaining approved devices. The selected device loses access to future keys.
Synchronization is paused. Stored keys, data and pending edits are retained.
Unsent local edits: %1$d. Their collections keep a local preview until the edits can be prepared for synchronization. Verified remote state remains stored.
A protected input window is unavailable. Close this screen and try again.
An optional passphrase changes your recovery identity. Preserve its exact characters and spaces separately from these words. It is required every time you use recovery authority.
Join using recovery authority

Select this relay as the source of the existing chain and verify its available signed history. This source does not independently prove that no unseen history was omitted. The original 24 words and exact optional passphrase are required.
Unimported changes remain on the source relay

Source %1$s has %2$d verified signed entries that were not imported (sequence %3$d–%4$d). They were not copied to the target. Keep the source relay and review its history before manually reapplying any needed changes.
